description: This is a unit test source file for testing key-value type classes within the WPEFramework project. It includes tests for the KeyValueType and TextKeyValueType templates, verifying their functionality such as equality, inequality, and key matching.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A template class for handling key-value pairs, tested here with string types to verify equality and key matching.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a text fragment, used in the TextKeyValueType template tests.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A template class binding a TextFragment key and an optional value, with case sensitivity options.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for KeyValueType class instances.

methods.name: Key()
methods.description: Returns the key component of a KeyValueType object.

methods.name: Value()
methods.description: Returns the value component of a KeyValueType object.

methods.name: IsKey()
methods.description: Checks if the provided string matches the key of the KeyValueType object.
